_about: Escape Soundscapes catalog: the 9 saved music categories x the Soundscapes AI modes (focus, calm, sleep, move, picks). Audio lives in GCS under soundscapes/{category}/{trackId}/ as AAC-LC .m4a segment sets (intro, 4 bodies, outro) per the Lucille audio spec. Static catalog = zero Firestore reads.

picks.label: Lucille Picks
picks.about: Lucille picks the mode from time of day, weather and your mood.

categories.label: Music Meditations
categories.description: Slow, melodic pieces to breathe and settle with.

categories.label: Vaporwave
categories.description: Hazy, nostalgic synth textures for easy focus and late nights.

categories.label: Jazz
categories.description: Soft lo-fi and late-night jazz that sits in the background.

categories.label: Nature
categories.description: Rain, ocean, forest and fire beds, gently mixed.

categories.label: Binaural Beats
categories.description: Stereo beat layers (headphones on) for focus, calm or sleep.
categories.disclaimer: Use headphones. Not for use while driving.

categories.label: Brainwave Music
categories.description: Music tuned around delta, theta, alpha and beta pulses.

categories.label: Raw Frequencies
categories.description: Pure tones and drones at named frequencies, nothing else.

categories.label: Sleep / Ambient Music
categories.description: Long, low, slowly evolving ambience for winding down and sleep.

categories.label: Music for Depression & Anxiety
categories.description: Gentle, steady music for heavy or anxious moments. A support, not a treatment.
categories.disclaimer: Music can support how you feel, but it isn't a treatment. If you're struggling, Lucille can share support resources any time.

categories.label: Vaporwave & Dreamdrift
categories.description: Slowed, tape-warm dream pop and drifting synth for late focus and long nights.
categories.disclaimer: A few tracks use headphone-only 8D panning; they're marked on the player.

categories.label: Nature Elements
categories.description: Water, wind, fire, stone and ice beds — single elements, held for a long time.
